head: Enough Phone gets 12GB RAM, 256GB storage and a bigger battery
dek: The small Android phone on Kickstarter moves from 8GB to 12GB of RAM, from 128GB to 256GB of storage and gets a 3,850 mAh battery, at no extra cost to backers. Backer tiers start at $449, retail is expected at $599, and it's due around May 2027.
